narration.text: And God remembered Noah, and every living thing, and all the cattle that was with him in the ark: and God made a wind to pass over the earth, and the waters asswaged;
Remembered. Not because God had forgotten them, but because the next move was His. A wind swept over the earth, and the great ocean began, slowly, to sink.

publish_decision.note: Defect list of local review 41680232127 and the frame sheet of this exact master (sha256 05181604...): no speech cut off (first words 'And God remembered Noah', last 'began slowly to sink', 0.25 s clear on both sides), the ark over the grey water fits every line, no audio error (-14.1 LUFS, true peak -1.9 dBTP, no silence inside speech), no policy issue. Emotional peak is 'Remembered. Not because God had forgotten them, but because the next move was His.' It ends with the waters starting to sink: the open loop is the long's ark landing on Ararat.
